metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Java) with a deployable entry point (Struts Action servlet deployed as WAR on WebLogic) and database connectivity. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connection with write operations (INSERT INTO applications) and a form-based CRUD workflow (loan submission). Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.18 < 1.5 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings (< 12 threshold) force Remediation Required tier. The system is extremely legacy across all dimensions but the High finding count falls just below the >=12 Not Ready threshold. Count-based tier is authoritative.

decomposition_strategy.rationale: Extreme legacy state (Java 5, Struts 1.3 EOL, WebLogic 10.3 EOL, Oracle 11g EOL). Technology stack requires complete replacement. Small codebase limits migration scope.

approaches.name: Strangler Fig (Parallel Track)
approaches.reason: Build new capabilities as cloud-native services, migrate incrementally

approaches.name: Conditional / Adaptive
approaches.reason: Cannot containerize as-is (Java 5 won't run on modern containers)

approaches.name: Big-Bang Rewrite
approaches.reason: Small codebase (single Action class) may make rewrite faster than incremental migration

effort_factors.data_coupling: High - direct JDBC in Action class
effort_factors.test_coverage: No automated tests - high regression risk

findings.title: No managed compute — all workloads on-premises WebLogic/Solaris
findings.description: All compute runs on Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3 on Solaris 10 (on-premises). No managed services, no cloud compute, no container orchestration, no serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute adoption. The entire runtime stack is on-premises and end-of-life.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed container orchestration (ECS/EKS with Fargate) or serverless (Lambda) after upgrading the Java runtime and framework.

findings.title: Self-managed Oracle 11g database on-premises
findings.description: Oracle 11g running on-premises at dbprod01:1521:LOANDB. Connection string hardcoded in LoanAction.java. No managed database service.
findings.gap: Database is entirely self-managed and on-premises with no managed service adoption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for Oracle (lift-and-shift) or Aurora PostgreSQL (modernize). Use AWS DMS for migration.

findings.title: No workflow orchestration for multi-step loan process
findings.description: Loan application workflow (quote → submit → save) is entirely hardcoded in LoanAction.execute(). No dedicated workflow orchestration service used.
findings.gap: No orchestration — all workflow logic hardcoded in application code.
findings.recommendation: Implement loan origination workflow using AWS Step Functions for visibility, error handling, and retry logic.

findings.title: No messaging or streaming infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging infrastructure. Loan submission is synchronous form POST → database INSERT with no event emission or downstream notification.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon SQS or EventBridge for loan application events. Emit events on state changes.

findings.title: No network security configuration
findings.description: No network security configuration found. Application runs on-premises on Solaris with WebLogic. No VPC, no subnets, no security groups.
findings.gap: No cloud network security infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a VPC with private subnets, least-privilege security groups, and proper tier segmentation.

findings.title: No API entry point — direct service exposure
findings.description: Services exposed directly via WebLogic with no API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront. No throttling, no request validation at entry.
findings.gap: No managed entry point. Direct service exposure without throttling or edge auth.
findings.recommendation: Deploy Amazon API Gateway or ALB as the entry point with throttling, validation, and authentication.

findings.title: No auto-scaling mechanisms
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. Application runs on static WebLogic instance on Solaris. All capacity statically provisioned.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. Cannot respond to traffic spikes.
findings.recommendation: Configure auto-scaling on target compute platform when migrating to AWS.

findings.title: No backup and recovery configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. Oracle 11g has no documented backup strategy, retention policy, or restore procedures.
findings.gap: No backup configuration. Data loss risk.
findings.recommendation: Enable automated backups with retention and PITR when migrating to RDS/Aurora.

findings.title: Zero Infrastructure as Code coverage
findings.description: 0% IaC coverage. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Helm. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: No IaC — all infrastructure created manually.
findings.recommendation: Define all target-state infrastructure in IaC (CDK or Terraform).

findings.title: No CI/CD automation — all deployments manual
findings.description: No CI/CD pipelines. Manual WAR upload via WebLogic admin console. Build uses Apache Ant with committed JARs.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments manual.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline + CodeBuild. Migrate build to Maven/Gradle.

findings.title: End-of-life language runtime and framework (Java 5, Struts 1.3)
findings.description: Java 5 with Apache Struts 1.3 (EOL since 2013). Java 5 cannot run any AWS SDK version. Framework has no security patches.
findings.gap: Language runtime and framework both end-of-life with no cloud-native tooling support.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x and AWS SDK v2.

findings.title: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries
findings.description: Single WAR deployment with all functionality in one Action class. Business logic, data access, and presentation co-located with no separation of concerns.
findings.gap: Pervasive shared state, no module boundaries, single deployment unit.
findings.recommendation: Apply Strangler Fig pattern to incrementally extract services. Establish module boundaries first.

findings.title: All communication synchronous with no async patterns
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No async patterns, no message queues, no event emission. For stateful-crud archetype, async state propagation is expected.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async event emission on state changes using SQS or EventBridge.

findings.title: All operations synchronous regardless of duration
findings.description: All operations synchronous. No background job processing, no status polling, no callback patterns. No capacity for long-running operations.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions with status polling APIs.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. Action mapped at /loan with no version prefix, no headers, no annotations.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-based versioning (e.g., /v1/loans) from day one on the replacement API.

findings.title: All service endpoints hardcoded
findings.description: Database connection string hardcoded as static final constant. No service registry, no environment variables, no dynamic discovery.
findings.gap: All endpoints hardcoded in application code.
findings.recommendation: Externalize connection strings to environment variables or AWS Service Discovery / Parameter Store.

findings.title: No managed object storage for unstructured data
findings.description: No S3 usage, no document parsing capabilities. Loan data stored only in Oracle relational database.
findings.gap: Data on on-premises Oracle with no managed object storage or parsing pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Store loan documents in Amazon S3. Add Textract for automated document extraction.

findings.title: No data access layer — raw JDBC in Action class
findings.description: Database connections and queries directly in the Struts Action class. Raw JDBC with DriverManager.getConnection and SQL string construction mixed with HTTP handling.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered in action class with no abstraction pattern.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a data access layer (Repository/DAO pattern or JPA/Spring Data).

findings.title: Database engine at end-of-life (Oracle 11g)
findings.description: Oracle 11g is past end-of-life. No version pinning in IaC. No version-update procedure documented.
findings.gap: Database engine at end-of-life with no version management.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL or RDS PostgreSQL. If Oracle retained, upgrade to Oracle 19c+ on RDS.

findings.title: No encryption at rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configured. Oracle 11g on-premises with no TDE or KMS. Sensitive loan data unencrypted.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for data stores containing sensitive loan application data.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS key when migrating to RDS/Aurora.

findings.title: Container-managed auth without OAuth2/JWT
findings.description: WebLogic realm-based authentication in use (evidenced by request.getRemoteUser()). Not token-based (OAuth2/JWT).
findings.gap: Authentication exists but is not token-based. No modern identity standards.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to OAuth2/JWT-based authentication using Amazon Cognito or external IdP.

findings.title: No centralized identity provider integration
findings.description: Authentication managed entirely by WebLogic internal realm. No OIDC, SAML, SSO, or external IdP federation.
findings.gap: Application manages own authentication with no external IdP integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or enterprise IdP with SAML/OIDC federation. Enable SSO.

findings.title: CRITICAL: Plaintext database credentials hardcoded in source code
findings.description: DB_PASS = "loanApp2010" hardcoded as static final constant in LoanAction.java. Credentials committed to version control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source code — critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credentials. Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: No compute hardening or patching strategy
findings.description: No patching strategy or vulnerability scanning. Solaris 10, WebLogic 10.3, Java 5, Struts 1.x all end-of-life with known vulnerabilities.
findings.gap: No patching strategy. Multiple components end-of-life with unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened base images (AL2023, Bottlerocket), enable SSM Patch Manager, integrate vulnerability scanning.

findings.title: No application security pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline exists to integrate scanning into. Dependencies committed as JARs with no version manifest.
findings.gap: No security scanning — no Dependabot, no SAST, no container scanning.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST, dependency scanning, and container scanning into the CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. Cannot trace requests through the system.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry SDK or AWS X-Ray when migrating to cloud-native architecture.

findings.title: No SLO definitions
findings.description: No SLO definitions. No availability targets, no latency targets, no error rate budgets, no monitoring artifacts.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for loan pricing and submission workflows. Implement monitoring with CloudWatch.

findings.title: No business metrics published
findings.description: No custom metrics. No business outcome metrics (applications submitted, approval rates). No dashboards.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no business outcome visibility.
findings.recommendation: Publish business metrics for loan origination using CloudWatch custom metrics.

findings.title: No anomaly detection or alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No anomaly detection, no threshold alarms, no incident management integration.
findings.gap: No alerting configured. Failures go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection. Integrate with PagerDuty/OpsGenie.

findings.title: No automated tests of any kind
findings.description: No unit tests, no integration tests, no test directories, no test frameworks. README: 'No unit tests; testing is a shared UAT environment.'
findings.gap: No integration tests — no automated tests at all.
findings.recommendation: Introduce automated testing from start of modernization. Add JUnit 5 + Testcontainers for integration tests.

findings.title: No observability ownership
findings.description: No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no CODEOWNERS for observability, no SLO definitions with team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define observability ownership. Create per-service dashboards with named owners.

pathways.name: Move to Open Source

triggering_questions.note: No stored procedures — primary trigger not met (requires DATA-Q4 < 3)

pathways.not_triggered_reason: DATA-Q4=4 — all business logic in application layer with standard SQL only. No stored procedures or proprietary SQL constructs that would drive open-source migration. Note: Oracle is commercial but the absence of proprietary SQL coupling means migration to PostgreSQL is straightforward without needing the Open Source pathway's SCT/stored-procedure-extraction guidance.
